snippet.title: Afterbeat - UGC Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/440310/

Levels Shown:

Volcano
By Mewnlight Rose  
https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3744731550

Imposter Syndrome
By Shirobon x FrankMusik 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3611979132

Jupiter
By The Eden Project
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3547537554

Mandragora
By Miyolophone
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3347900951

Terminally Online
By Glitch Cat & Wh1teskyy
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3742932429

Beastmode
By Teminite
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2540014969

Description: 
Afterbeat is a new take on the classic SHMUP / Bullet Hell genre. This time, everything is synced to the music.

You dodge the rhythmically timed shapes as you navigate through each song; no shooting required.
Each level is designed to evoke a sense of synesthesia within you from start to finish, just as if you were actually “playing” a music video.

Socials:
BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/vitamin.games
Discord: https://discord.gg/projectarrhythmia
Website: https://vitamin.games

Featuring Music By:
Akira Complex / Chipzel / Shirobon / Meganeko / Andrew Allanson / Creo / and More!
